'''LevitaRest''' was a furniture manufacturing company. Two LevitaRest couches were used by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[43 ABY]] to furnish her [[Chief of State's Suite|offices]] within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].
